headline: Strategic Bases Flip Amid Rising Carnage
war_summary: Three hours on, the frenzy of base turnover has softened in the hottest sectors yet the slaughter remains staggering. Weathered Expanse still leads with fifty‑eight ownership flips in the past day — up from fifty‑three — while colonial losses climb to 312,848 and Warden losses to 370,425. Linn Mercy records thirty‑six exchanges, a modest rise from thirty‑three, with a two‑hour surge of 2,741 colonial and 2,575 Warden casualties. Nevish Line now shows thirty‑nine flips, up from twenty‑nine, and both sides bleed heavily: 1,968 colonial and 2,204 Warden dead in the last two hours. Mooring County’s activity has slipped to sixteen flips from twenty, casualties easing to fifteen colonial and thirty‑two Warden in the same window. Stonecradle holds steady at fourteen flips, its Warden toll rising to 142 in two hours. Marban Hollow’s exchanges have dwindled to three, though Warden casualties continue to climb (71 in two hours). Rear‑area hexes — Callahans Passage, Dead Lands and the bulk of the map — remain static, bleeding heavily without base movement. Enlistments are rising modestly in the active zones, feeding fresh manpower into the grinder.
